verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure for the new shape: quote mark, quote, and attribution grouped on the left, logo bottom-left, can on its circle to the right. Its quote text is small but readable and the attribution sits tight under it. B jams the logo into the top-right corner beside the quote, splits the attribution far below the quote with a gap, wraps the quote into a narrow, choppy column and leaves the can small and crowded against it, so grouping and hierarchy break down.
